biography: Bobby Hamilton, a name synonymous with raw talent and unpredictable brilliance, hails from the dusty backroads of Alabama. His racing journey began not in a kart, but behind the wheel of his granddaddy's beat-up pickup, tearing through fields and learning car control by necessity. He quickly gained a reputation for pushing limits, a trait that caught the eye of a local Stock USA Gen2 team owner after Bobby won a particularly chaotic dirt track race, narrowly avoiding a flipped tractor tire. Despite flashes of brilliance, his career has been marked by inconsistency. A string of podiums in his early seasons showed promise, but off-track issues and a tendency to crack under pressure have held him back. Now, at 28, Bobby's at a crossroads. He's still with Stock USA Gen2, but the patience is wearing thin. This season is make-or-break, a chance to prove he can harness his talent and become the champion everyone knows he could be.
drivingStyle: Bobby's driving style is all about aggression and instinct. He attacks every corner like it's the last, often throwing his car into turns with a daring slide that leaves fans breathless. His tire management, however, is suspect. He tends to burn through his rubber early in the race, leaving him vulnerable in the closing laps. Under pressure, Bobby can either rise to the occasion with a stunning overtake or crumble with a costly mistake – there's rarely an in-between. He thrives on the chaos of close racing, where his improvisational skills and quick reflexes give him an edge.

rivalries.reason: A clash of styles. Jake's calculated precision clashes with Bobby's all-out aggression, leading to frequent on-track battles and the occasional paint-swapping incident.
A championship rivalry that began when Ricardo accused Bobby of intentionally wrecking him at the season finale, costing him the title. The animosity has been simmering ever since.
A battle of wits and strategy. Bobby often disregards team orders, frustrating Ashley, his crew chief. This leads to heated arguments in the pit lane and a constant struggle for control.

quirks: Always wears the same lucky pair of worn-out cowboy boots, no matter the weather.
Listens to old blues records on repeat before every race, claiming it calms his nerves (though no one else believes it).
Has a peculiar habit of talking to his car, offering pep talks and apologies after a particularly rough session.
famousQuote: "Racing ain't about playing it safe. It's about pushing it 'til the wheels fall off, and then pushing it some more."
careerHighlight: Winning the Stock USA Gen2 Championship race at Daytona in a last-lap, three-wide overtake, silencing his doubters and proving his potential.
careerLowPoint: Crashing out of the lead with only two laps remaining at the biggest race of the season, costing him a guaranteed victory and severely damaging his reputation.
